draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.17, the 111th-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 3rd of 13 at QB. He went 25th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (111th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Published comparison: Gardner Minshew. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: his final season (2024) ranked 3rd in passing yards among the 13 QBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the New York Giants (reserve). 14 career games and 12 starts over 1 completed season, plus 2 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (11 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: interceptions thrown 5 (85th percentile), rushing yards 487 (81st percentile). Versus the typical Year-1 quarterback who played: 2,272 passing yards against a median of 1,341, above the norm.
